name: IT Service Desk Analyst
description: Performs AIOps-driven service operations within the Data & AI value stream, resolving incidents through auto-remediation and runbook automation. Maintains event correlation, service topology mapping, and ML-based anomaly detection, retiring obsolete runbooks and verifying permanent fixes. Reviews automation effectiveness quarterly and upholds AIOps model governance.

name: Identity Access Manager
description: Administers identity lifecycle management and directory services across the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream. Runs access certifications and approval workflows, distributing reviewer line items, escalating overdue reviews, and tracking completion. Operates multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and federation on the IAM platform, monitoring directory replication health and securing compliance sign-off for sensitive-system access.

name: Implementation Specialist
description: Owns go-live readiness assessments within the Product & Delivery value stream. Confirms operational readiness across teams, verifies state filing approvals ahead of launch, and validates rating-engine premium accuracy alongside production environments and deployment artifacts. Establishes post-launch monitoring cadence and archives readiness evidence for audit.

name: Incident Responder Digital Forensics Analyst
description: Performs incident investigation and service restoration for the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, triaging escalated SOC alerts and enumerating compromised identities. Executes containment and recovery — re-credentialing accounts, reimaging endpoints, and coordinating restoration with disaster recovery. Drives incident preparedness through playbook updates, tabletop exercises, and post-incident reviews with metrics reporting.

name: Incident Response Lead
description: Leads identity and access control operations across the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, driving access certification and entitlement review cycles to completion. Oversees privileged account onboarding, privileged activity auditing, and service account rotation compliance. Monitors directory services health, administers multi-factor authentication, and validates directory backup and restoration quarterly.

name: Infrastructure / Network Engineer
description: Owns infrastructure-as-code and environment lifecycle management within the Technology & Engineering value stream, with supporting work across Cybersecurity and Data & AI. Maintains IaC module libraries and Helm charts, retiring deprecated versions and migrating consumers. Manages secrets rotation, certificate management, and web application firewall configuration, reporting cloud security posture drift to governance.

name: Instructional Designer
description: Develops learning content and leadership development programs across the Human Resources & Talent value stream. Builds SCORM course packages, schedules cohort workshops, and manages content review and retirement cycles. Tracks certifications and licensing through the credential register, generates mandatory training compliance attestations, and embeds privacy guidance into HR learning records.

name: Insurance Product Dev Lead
description: Leads product delivery within the Product & Delivery value stream, coordinating business acceptance testing, release planning, and deployment through the CAB. Prioritizes the product backlog against value and roadmap, coaches product owners and squads, and drives sprint planning. Manages release communications and monitors post-deployment business metrics to fuel continuous improvement.

name: Insurance Product Manager
description: Owns product releases across the Product & Delivery value stream, driving business readiness planning and business acceptance testing coordination. Tracks readiness completion with weekly status reporting, drafts and distributes release notes, and maintains the release calendar and lessons-learned log. Prioritizes the backlog against value and roadmap while coaching product owners on the agile delivery framework.

name: Integration Architect
description: Oversees infrastructure-as-code standards and environment lifecycle management within the Technology & Engineering value stream, extending into Cybersecurity and Data & AI. Governs the CMDB and data pipeline CI/CD, retiring deprecated IaC modules and migrating consumers to approved versions. Defines secret rotation policies, manages certificates, and reports cloud security posture drift to governance.

name: Integration Developer
description: Builds and maintains data pipeline CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code within the Technology & Engineering value stream, with supporting Cybersecurity and Data & AI work. Maintains Helm chart libraries, retires deprecated IaC modules, and enforces workload onboarding deployment standards. Configures automated secret rotation, certificate management, and web application firewall rules, contributing to cloud posture reporting.

name: Integration Engineer
description: Owns integration development and testing across the Technology & Engineering value stream, spanning Cybersecurity, Data & AI, and distribution work. Manages the event streaming platform and partner connectivity, onboarding applications to SSO and managing identity federation trusts. Enforces API design standards and API security, scanning container images and IaC templates in build pipelines and executing post-merger entity integration.

name: Internal Auditor
description: Performs risk-based audit planning and engagement execution across the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream. Tests operational controls and compliance, triaging analytics exceptions, re-testing failed controls, and validating deficiency closure evidence on the GRC platform. Tracks remediation of findings to closure, supports market conduct examinations, and routes policy drafts through governance workflows.
